task: Review every supplied part, discover the most consequential events from the supplied evidence, cluster related reports, assign the best-fit broad news category dynamically and produce up to 150 processed stories using schema/processed-news.schema.json. The final portfolio must contain at least five well-supported stories in every category. Treat social attention as a discovery signal rather than verification. More than half of the final stories must originate with independent, local or social discovery, using the first source in each story as the discovery source; established outlets may account for no more than half.

items.title: BRS sends legal notice to Telugu daily over claims of water diversion to KCR’s farmhouse
items.summary: The Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) has sent a legal notice to the Telugu newspaper Velugu, owned by Congress Minister Gaddam Vivek Venkatswamy, over a story alleging that water from the Kondapochamma Sagar Reservoir has been diverted to former Chief Minister K Chandrashekar Rao’s farmhouse in Erravalli village of Siddipet district. Accusing Velugu of publishing a false story against KCR, the BRS legal cell has demanded an unconditional apology to be carried on the front page, warning that the newspaper’s editor and management would otherwise face a defamation suit. The report published in Velugu on October 17 included images of a three-acre well filled with water allegedly part of KCR’s farmhouse. It also showed satellite images of a water body called Panduranga Cheruvu (lake) near the farmhouse spread over 58 acres, alleging that it was completely dry in 2017 but had been filled up with water by 2021 from the Kondapochamma Sagar reservoir, which is part of the Kaleshwaram irrigation project.
